61114-westy-martin-in-the-yellowstone.title: Westy Martin In The Yellowstone
61114-westy-martin-in-the-yellowstone.creator: Percy Keese Fitzhugh
61114-westy-martin-in-the-yellowstone.description: A book by Percy Keese Fitzhugh. When Westy Martin and his two companions, Warde Hollister and Ed Carlyle, were on their long journey to the Yellowstone National Park, they derived much amusement from talking with a man whose acquaintance they made on the train.

arxiv-2105-12308.creator: Dallas Albritton, Rajendra Beekie, Matthew Novack
arxiv-2105-12308.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dallas Albritton, Rajendra Beekie, Matthew Novack. We examine the phenomenon of enhanced dissipation from the perspective of Hörmander’s classical theory of second order hypoelliptic operators [ 31 ] . arxiv-2108-05330.title: Annihilation-to-nothing : DeWitt boundary condition inside a black hole
arxiv-2108-05330.creator: Suddhasattwa Brahma a , Che-Yu Chen b , and Dong-han Yeom c,d
arxiv-2108-05330.description: Abstract In canonical quantum gravity, the wave function for a hypersurface inside a Schwarzschild black hole can be obtained by solving the Wheeler-DeWitt equation. What is of prime importance is the behavior of the wave function for the future boundary near the singularity, and the DeWitt boundary condition implies that it should vanish here.

arxiv-2208-09333.title: Text to Image Generation: Leaving no Language Behind
arxiv-2208-09333.creator: Pedro Reviriego, Elena Merino-Gómez
arxiv-2208-09333.description: Abstract One of the latest applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is to generate images from natural language descriptions. These generators are now becoming available and achieve impressive results that have been used for example in the front cover of magazines.

arxiv-2210-11111.title: The Pump Scheduling Problem: A Real-World Scenario for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2210-11111.creator: Henrique Donâncio, Laurent Vercouter, Harald Roclawski
arxiv-2210-11111.description: Abstract Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has demonstrated impressive results in domains such as games and robotics, where task formulations are well-defined. However, few DRL benchmarks are grounded in complex, real-world environments, where safety constraints, partial observability, and the need for hand-engineered task representations pose significant challenges.

arxiv-2302-02072.title: An Inexact Deflected Subgradient Algorithm in Infinite Dimensional spaces
arxiv-2302-02072.creator: Regina S. Burachik, Xuemei Liu
arxiv-2302-02072.description: Abstract We propose a duality scheme for solving constrained nonsmooth and nonconvex optimization problems in a reflexive Banach space. We establish strong duality for a very general type of augmented Lagrangian, in which we assume a less restrictive type of coercivity on the augmenting function.

arxiv-2302-03620.title: Recent advances in the Self-Referencing Embedding Strings (SELFIES) library
arxiv-2302-03620.creator: Alston Lo, Robert Pollice, AkshatKumar Nigam, Andrew D. White, Mario Krenn, Alán Aspuru-Guzik
arxiv-2302-03620.description: Abstract String-based molecular representations play a crucial role in cheminformatics applications, and with the growing success of deep learning in chemistry, have been readily adopted into machine learning pipelines. However, traditional string-based representations such as S MILES are often prone to syntactic and semantic errors when produced by generative models.

arxiv-2307-08475.title: SIMPLE: Simple Intensity Map Producer for Line Emission astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) ; matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) ; numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) ; scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) ; pmesh ( Feng et al. 2017 ) ; da
arxiv-2307-08475.creator: Maja Lujan Niemeyer, José Luis Bernal, Eiichiro Komatsu
arxiv-2307-08475.description: Abstract We present the Simple Intensity Map Producer for Line Emission ( Simple ), a public code for quickly simulating mock line-intensity maps, and an analytical framework for modeling intensity maps including observational effects. Simple can be applied to any spectral line sourced by galaxies.

arxiv-2410-11203.title: Error Diffusion: Post Training Quantization with Block-Scaled Number Formats for Neural Networks
arxiv-2410-11203.creator: Alireza Khodamoradi, Kristof Denolf, Eric Dellinger, first.last@amd.com
arxiv-2410-11203.description: Abstract Quantization reduces the model’s hardware costs, such as data movement, storage, and operations like multiply and addition. It also affects the model’s behavior by degrading the output quality. Therefore, there is a need for methods that preserve the model’s behavior when quantizing model parameters.

arxiv-2412-12730.title: Thin film flow over a spinning disc: Experiments and direct numerical simulations
arxiv-2412-12730.creator: Jason Stafford, Nwachukwu Uzo, Enrico Piccoli, Camille Petit, Omar K. Matar
arxiv-2412-12730.description: Abstract The dynamics of thin liquid films flowing over a spinning disc is studied through a combination of experiments and direct numerical simulations. We consider a comprehensive range of interfacial flow regimes from waveless through to three-dimensional (3D) waves, and for previously unexplored inertia-dominated conditions that have practical relevance.

arxiv-2503-23997.title: On the origin of Jupiter’s fuzzy core: constraints from N-body, impact, and evolution simulations Facilities: Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (Piz Daint, Alps.Eiger)
arxiv-2503-23997.creator: Thomas Meier, Christian Reinhardt, Sho Shibata, Simon Müller, Joachim Stadel, Ravit Helled
arxiv-2503-23997.description: Abstract It has been suggested that Jupiter’s fuzzy core could be a result of a giant impact. Here, we investigate the expected impact conditions from N-body simulations. We then use state-of-the-art SPH simulations to investigate the results of impacts with different conditions including various impactor masses and composition, different formation stages in Jupiter’s growth, and different resolutions.

arxiv-2511-05655.title: Dynamical mirages: how bar-induced resonant trapping can mimic substructure clustering in dynamical parameter spaces
arxiv-2511-05655.creator: M. De Leo, D. Massari, M. Bellazzini, A. Mucciarelli, B. Acosta-Tripailao, C. Nipoti
arxiv-2511-05655.description: Abstract Context. The complex task of unraveling the assembly history of the Milky Way is in constant evolution with new substructures identified continuously. To properly validate and characterise the family of galactic progenitors, it is important to take into account all the effects that can shape the distribution of tracers in the Galaxy.

britannica-1911-warner-olin-levi.title: Warner, Olin Levi (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-warner-olin-levi.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-warner-olin-levi.description: Article 'Warner, Olin Levi' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. born at West Suffield, Connecticut, on the 9th of April 1844. In turn an artisan and a telegraph operator, by 1869 he had earned enough money to support him through a course of study in Paris under Jouffroy and Carpeaux. He was in France when the Republic was proclaimed in 1870 and enlisted in the Foreign Legion, resuming his studies at the termination of the siege.

pmc-10582294.title: Valorization of wipe wastes for the synthesis of microporous carbons and their application in CO2 capture, gas separation and H2-storage☆
pmc-10582294.creator: JA Cecilia, E Vilarrasa-García, DCS Azevedo, A Vílchez-Cózar, A Infantes-Molina, D Ballesteros-Plata, I Barroso-Martín, E Rodríguez-Castellón
pmc-10582294.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Wipe wastes have been used as a cellulosic source to synthesize biochars. Prior to the synthesis of the adsorbents by the pyrolysis of wipes wastes, this waste was treated to remove the pathogenic agents. Then, the wipe wastes were pyrolyzed between 500 and 900 °C to obtain biochars, whose microporosity increased proportionally to the pyrolysis temperature, achieving a maximum CO2-adsorption uptake of 2.53 mmol/g at a pressure of 760 mm of Hg and 25 °C for the biochar pyrolized at 900 °C.

pmc-11456855.title: Mitigation of allergic asthma in mice: A compound mixture comprising luteolin, arbutin, and marmesin from Gerbera Piloselloides Herba by suppression of PI3K/Akt pathway
pmc-11456855.creator: Chunhua Liu, Yu He, Kun Zhou, Hong Wang, Meng Zhou, Jia Sun, Yuan Lu, Yong Huang, Yonglin Wang, Ting Liu, Yongjun Li
pmc-11456855.description: BackgroundGerberae Piloselloidis Herba (GPH) exhibits notable efficacy in alleviating allergic asthma. Previous studies in our research have identified a mixture of luteolin, arbutin, and marmesin as effective components of GPH in treating allergic asthma. However, the underlying mechanism remains unclear. This study aims to elucidate the molecular mechanism of these active components.

pmc-11504024.title: His Bundle Pacing and Left Bundle Branch Pacing in Patients with Heart Failure
pmc-11504024.creator: Patrycja Paluszkiewicz, Adrian Martuszewski, Jadwiga Radziejewska, Jacek Zawadzki, Jacek Smereka, Jacek Gajek
pmc-11504024.description: Background: His bundle pacing (HBP) and left bundle branch pacing (LBBP) are emerging therapies for patients with heart failure and conduction disorders, offering potential advantages over traditional pacing methods. These approaches aim to restore physiological conduction and improve cardiac function more effectively.

pmc-11598551.title: Enhancing the Non-Isothermal Crystallization Kinetics of Polylactic Acid by Incorporating a Novel Nucleating Agent
pmc-11598551.creator: Ruijie Jin, Zehong Chen, Yidan Ouyang, Xintu Lin, Xin Dai, Shangxi Zhang, Ruilan Xu, Zhengbao Wang, Yong Peng
pmc-11598551.description: Polylactic acid (PLA) is a widely recognized biodegradable polymer. However, the slow crystallization rate of PLA restricts its practical applications. In this study, camphor leaf biochar decorated with multi-walled carbon nanotubes (C@MWCNTs) was prepared using the strong adhesive properties of polydopamine, and PLA/C@MWCNTs composites were fabricated via the casting solution method.

pmc-12516561.title: The cytoplasmic domain of the pseudoprotease iRhom2 mediates distinct signaling mechanisms to control activation of the cell surface protease ADAM17
pmc-12516561.creator: Fangfang Lu, Marjorie Fournier, Matthew Freeman
pmc-12516561.description: ADAM17 is a cell surface protease that controls the release of the ectodomains of signaling proteins, including epidermal growth factor receptor ligands and the primary inflammatory cytokine tumor necrosis factor. Reflecting this important role in signaling, dysregulated ADAM17 activity is linked to many human diseases, including immunodeficiency, inflammatory bowel disease, rheumatic arthritis, cancer, and Alzheimer's disease.

pmc-12520919.title: Severe COVID-19 induces prolonged elevation of the acute-phase protein pentraxin 3
pmc-12520919.creator: Bernhard Kratzer, Robert B. Stieger, Seyma Durmus, Doris Trapin, Pia Gattinger, Paul Ettel, Al Nasar Ahmed Sehgal, Kristina Borochova, Yulia Dorofeeva, Inna Tulaeva, Katharina Grabmeier-Pfistershammer, Peter A. Tauber, Marika Gerdov, Thomas Perkmann, Ingrid Fae, Sabine Wenda, Michael Kundi, Sebastia
pmc-12520919.description: IntroductionDuring the acute-phase of COVID-19, elevated levels of several acute-phase proteins, such as C-reactive protein (CRP), mannose-binding lectin (MBL), pentraxin 3 (PTX-3), serum amyloid A (SAA) and surfactant protein D (SP-D), are associated with severe to fatal clinical outcomes. Typically, these markers return to baseline within days after resolution of the acute infection.

pmc-13074057.title: Gastric-Type Mixed Neoplastic and Non-Neoplastic Lesions in the Duodenal Bulb: A Case Supporting the Metaplasia–Neoplasia Sequence
pmc-13074057.creator: Hidetoshi Satomi, Noriya Uedo, Shingo Ishiguro, Yoshiki Kairiku, Tomoki Michida, Ryu Ishihara, Keiichiro Honma
pmc-13074057.description: Gastric-type lesions in the duodenum, including pyloric gland adenoma and gastric foveolar metaplasia, have been increasingly recognized for their unique histogenesis and potential link through the metaplasia–neoplasia sequence. However, the coexistence of neoplastic and non-neoplastic gastric-type lesions within the same histological section has not been previously reported.

pmc-13180677.title: Development and Validation of Machine Learning-Based Models for Predicting Postoperative Depression Risk in Patients With Ovarian Cancer
pmc-13180677.creator: Jitong Zhao, Kaige Pei, Junhan Liu, Ce Bian, Chen Ling
pmc-13180677.description: Objective:To develop machine learning-based prediction models for postoperative depression risk in patients with ovarian cancer and to evaluate their predictive performance and clinical application value.Methods:Clinical data from 850 postoperative patients with ovarian cancer were retrospectively analysed. Postoperative depression risk was defined as positive when Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) score was ≥10.

pmc-13196696.title: Exploring the therapeutic potential of β-nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in regulating canine NT-proBNP levels
pmc-13196696.creator: Zipeng Jiang, Liang Mei, Zhiyi Huang
pmc-13196696.description: Objectives: N-terminal pro–B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) is a key biomarker for assessing cardiac function in companion animals and plays a critical role in the diagnosis and management of heart disease. β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN), a precursor of NAD+, has attracted attention for its potential to enhance mitochondrial function and energy metabolism.

pmc-13261570.title: Assessment of Psychometric Properties of the Persian Version of the Medication Literacy Measure
pmc-13261570.creator: Mona Kargar, Soha Namazi, Ava Mansouri, Mohadeseh Balvardi, Kheirollah Gholami
pmc-13261570.description: Objective:Given the association between medication literacy (ML) and its correct use, assessing the status of ML is essential in the community. This study aimed to validate a Persian-language ML assessment instrument, addressing the lack of a previously validated Persian tool.Methods:This was a cross-sectional study conducted in Tehran. A database search was conducted to identify current tools.

pmc-13452185.title: Machine learning-guided screening and validation of antioxidant small molecules from Clausena lansium
pmc-13452185.creator: Yufan Tong, Min Wang

pmc-13455311.title: Using an asset mapping approach to evaluate the reach of community-level health equity interventions
pmc-13455311.creator: Kara Hollins, Sharon Fitzgerald Wolff, Daniel J. Parente, Edward F. Ellerbeck, Christina M. Pacheco, Antonio Miras Neira, Kevin J. Sykes, Elizabeth Ablah, Sarah Finocchario-Kessler
pmc-13455311.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAsset Mapping Score Analysis (AMSA) is a standardized approach to organizing data on community assets. This study uses AMSA in two ways to quantify health equity efforts of the Communities Organizing to Promote Equity (COPE) project: (1) quantify community assets identified by COPE; and (2) apply AMSA methods in a novel way to evaluate the reach and depth of COPE interventions.MethodsCOPE aimed to strengthen community-driven public health by establishing community coalitions, called Local Health Equity Action Teams, in 20 Kansas counties.
